findings.summary: EXPECT_GE(GetRingChunkCountForTest(), chunksBefore + 2) does not prove what its message says ('the 4096 draws of a frame spanned at least three ring chunks'): GetRingChunkCountForTest sums the chunks of BOTH frame slots and chunksBefore is 0 (chunks are made lazily), so one chunk per slot already passes.
findings.scenario: Today each frame needs 4096 x (192+128 aligned) >= 1.31 MB, i.e. 3 chunks (256K+512K+1M), so coverage is real; but if FirstChunkSize grew to e.g. 4 MB every draw would sit in chunk 0, the test would silently stop exercising chunk chaining, and the guard assertion would still pass (2 slots x 1 chunk). Assert per frame (e.g. count after the first frame >= 3, or a per-slot accessor).

findings.summary: The new Transparent-queue scene's measured numbers are not reported anywhere: testing.html defers to the test log line '[ cross-diff ] transparent queue back to front', which exists in the test's stdout but ctest runs with --output-on-failure, so the passing CI log of 0548a8c does not contain it; the PR body does not mention the new test or its numbers either.
findings.scenario: Brief: 'Report the measured numbers ... of every compared scene in the PR body'. A reader following the docs to the CI log finds nothing; the strict pass only bounds the max at 2/255. Copy the numbers from a run of renderer_tests (or a one-off print) into the PR body and testing.html, or reword the docs.
